transient_retry.eligibility: attempt incomplete without evaluator error; every native session complete, not started, or failed with a retained provider HTTP 5xx
transient_retry.what_counts: the final attempt of each cell must be complete and accounted; every earlier attempt is retained and published with its usage and latency
transient_retry.reporting: cells that needed a rerun, total reruns and first-attempt status counts are published beside the result

unchanged_from_sol100: completeness, nonempty aggregate evidence and actual complete assessor criteria
changed_from_sol100: recorded rerun of cells stopped only by upstream HTTP 5xx
job rerun budget 6 instead of r1's 12 (spend bound)
specialists: not qualified by this schedule: original pilot paths do not activate built-in routing
semantic_quality: provisional; actual human adjudication remains outstanding
fallback: none: this is one of two further reliability draws (r2, r3) of the unchanged profile; both outcomes are retained and counted whatever they are; no post-hoc exclusion; no further schedule is conditional on this result

reliability_estimate_declared_before_lau.schedule_level: schedules passing the unchanged gate / all schedules of this model, ceiling, prompt and inputs: original Sol100k (failed), r1 (passed), r2, r3; Wilson 95% interval on 4
reliability_estimate_declared_before_lau.cell_level: cells complete and accounted on the first attempt / 144 scheduled cells across the same four schedules; Wilson 95% interval, reported with the caveat that cells within one schedule share an upstream window and are not independent
reliability_estimate_declared_before_lau.rerun_accounting: a cell completed only after a rerun counts as an accounting failure and as not complete on first attempt; a schedule with any such cell fails all_runs_complete_and_accounted under the scorer but the gate records final-attempt completion separately
reliability_estimate_declared_before_lau.gate_reading: pass requires the final attempt of every cell complete and accounted, as r1; cells needing a rerun and first-attempt status are published beside it
